title: Port simple controls and disclosure families with source-exact composition
description: WHY: Deliver separator, button, toggle, toggle-group, avatar, progress, meter, collapsible, accordion, tabs and toolbar as independently schedulable component work. Canonical source is /Users/avi/avir-oss/ref/base-ui at 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505; never consult the old Solid port. Target Solid 2 RC.13. IN SCOPE: only child-owned component directories, colocated tests/fixtures, component docs and tracking/components/<family>.json. OUT OF SCOPE: shared foundation implementation, root barrels, package export maps, package manifests and lockfiles; those belong to foundation/integration owners. ORDER: start all ready children concurrently; dependency arrays, not this epic, control scheduling. Button owns a reusable button-behavior adapter within its directory. Toolbar precedes ToggleGroup, which precedes Toggle; this avoids reverse dependencies caused by upstream integration tests. Collapsible precedes Accordion. Other ready families run independently. CONTRACT: class, live render(props,state) callbacks rather than JSX cloning, native events, independent details.cancel() and preventBaseUIHandler(), getter-backed public state, accessor/memo derivation, createEffect(compute,effect) with returned cleanup, staged ordinary writes without setter/read assumptions, current callbacks at invocation, setup-owned ref cleanup, optional contexts explicitly null and required contexts defaultless. Preserve exact undefined/null defaults, data attributes and CSS variables. VALIDATE: children translate source test cases and record source test title, target test, environment, result or justified framework adaptation, and command in their coverage JSON. Bootstrap/harness must publish target jsdom, browser, SSR/hydration and type-check commands; do not assume React workspace scripts exist in the empty target. Cross-family cases unavailable during a worker's turn are translated as contract fixtures and explicitly handed to integration for real-component replay, never counted as executed end-to-end coverage.
acceptance: All eleven families have explicit task ownership and only real prerequisite dependencies.
Every child has source-pinned behavior, Solid-native constraints and a test/coverage handoff.
No component worker owns shared barrels, manifests, lockfiles or another family's implementation.

title: Port public field and form controls over the shared validation engine
description: WHY: Public form components must share one registration/validation engine without forcing that engine to depend on public Field. Canonical source is /Users/avi/avir-oss/ref/base-ui at 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505, never the old Solid port. Target Solid 2 RC.13. IN SCOPE: Field, Fieldset, Form, Input, Checkbox/CheckboxGroup, Radio/RadioGroup and Switch. ORDER: fieldset and form can start against foundation contracts independently; Field shell follows fieldset, then Field.Control/error/validity, then Input. Checkbox plus CheckboxGroup share one task and Radio plus RadioGroup share one task to keep bidirectional registrations under a single owner. Switch is independent of the public Field sequence. Field-core owns shared form/field contexts, registration and validation mechanics; public components consume it and never reimplement it or make core import a public component. Resolve missing context seams with the foundation owner, not cross-directory edits. CONTRACT: class instead of className; render callback receives live props/state; native event objects with independent cancellation mechanisms; getter-backed reactive state, accessor/memo derivation, createEffect(compute,effect), returned cleanup, staged writes, callback lookup at invocation, setup-owned ref disposal, explicitly-null optional contexts and defaultless required contexts. Preserve source-specific null handling, native hidden inputs, label ownership and form-value projection. WRITE BOUNDARY: child owns only its listed family directories, family tests/fixtures/docs and coverage files. Integration owns root barrels, export map and lockfile. VALIDATE: translate all applicable source tests, separating React-only scheduling assertions from user-visible behavior; record each case and target environment/command in tracking/components/<family>.json. Harness commands are a prerequisite, not guessed target scripts. Real multi-family replay belongs in the integration handoff when only foundation contract fixtures can run during independent work.
acceptance: Field-core has no dependency on public Field, Form or controls.
Checkbox/group and radio/group ownership is atomic and their coverage remains separately attributable.
All public families include native submission, validation, reactive labeling and cleanup evidence.

title: Port numeric, OTP and scroll families in independent sequential tracks
description: WHY: NumberField, Slider, OTPField and ScrollArea combine state, DOM and platform-sensitive interaction; family-local sequences prevent concurrent edits to one root while allowing all four tracks to run in parallel. Canonical source is /Users/avi/avir-oss/ref/base-ui at 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505. Never use the old Solid port. Target Solid 2 RC.13. ORDER: NumberField model -> editing/steppers -> scrubbing; Slider model -> keyboard/forms -> gestures/geometry; OTP model -> slot editing/completion; ScrollArea layout -> gestures. Scope each stage to its described behavior, leaving later tests explicitly assigned to the next ID in coverage. Shared foundation is consumed read-only. CONTRACT: class, live render callback rather than JSX cloning, native events with independent details.cancel() and preventBaseUIHandler(), getter-backed public state, accessor/memo derivation, createEffect(compute,effect) with returned cleanup, ordinary staged writes without immediate rereads, current prop callbacks, setup-owned ref cleanup, optional contexts explicitly null and required contexts defaultless. Preserve exact defaults and all data/CSS-variable contracts. Pointer transactions may keep event-local/ref snapshots for synchronous native work; never silently assume a Solid setter commits immediately. WRITE BOUNDARY: listed family implementation, colocated tests/fixtures, family docs and tracking/components/<family>.json only. Root barrels, package exports and lockfile are integration-owned. VALIDATE: translate the pinned source suites and type specs, record per-case environment and results, and use actual commands published by bootstrap/harness. Layout, pointer capture, IME/platform and prehydration cases require appropriate browser evidence or a specifically documented integration runner blocker, not jsdom-only claims. Final family stages audit the entire index export surface and coverage inventory.
acceptance: Four independent family tracks can run concurrently once their listed foundations are ready.
Each complex family has two or three narrowly scoped sequential tasks with shared ownership serialized by dependencies.
Final stages reconcile runtime, types, browser behavior and source-test coverage.

title: Implement Separator semantics and reactive orientation
description: WHY: Separator is a small, independently deliverable accessibility primitive and a prerequisite for Toolbar and OTPField aliases. Use the web/source implementation as the canonical reference, pinned to 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505; do not approximate the source structure or use the old Solid port. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/separator/index.ts, Separator.tsx, SeparatorDataAttributes.ts and Separator.test.tsx under that family. IMPLEMENT: reproduce the default div, separator role, horizontal orientation default, aria-orientation for both axes and orientation state/data attribute. Match consumer prop precedence through the render foundation rather than hardcoding attributes after consumer overrides. Preserve ref forwarding and the exact family exports/types. Implement orientation as an accessor/memo and expose getter-backed state so changing a prop updates the DOM and class/style/render callbacks without replacing the component. Use class instead of className and render(liveProps,liveState), never cloning an already-instantiated JSX node. Default only undefined where the source defaults undefined; do not add an undocumented decorative mode or alter invalid-value behavior. This task needs no private state engine, effect or broad shared helper. If ref composition needs disposal, register cleanup at setup because ref callbacks have no owner in Solid 2 RC.13. WRITE BOUNDARY: packages/solid/src/separator/** including colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/separator/** and tracking/components/separator.json. Family-local index files are permitted; root barrels, package exports and lockfile belong to integration. NON-GOALS: Toolbar-specific perpendicular orientation, OTP composition, shared renderer changes or styling. VALIDATE: translate every case in Separator.test.tsx, including conformance, both orientations and prop override/ref behavior. Add signal-driven prop and live callback type checks with the harness's published commands. Record each upstream case, target test, result and command in tracking/components/separator.json and supply export requirements to integration.
acceptance: Default output is a div with role=separator and horizontal aria/data orientation.
Changing orientation updates DOM and public callback state reactively.
Custom render callbacks, class/style callbacks, refs and consumer overrides pass conformance.
All applicable source tests and type checks are mapped with results in tracking/components/separator.json.

title: Implement Button and a family-owned native/non-native activation adapter
description: WHY: Button establishes keyboard activation and disabled semantics reused by disclosure and selection controls; one adapter prevents each worker inventing subtly different clicks. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/button/index.ts, Button.tsx, Button.test.tsx and packages/react/src/internals/use-button/useButton.ts. Canonical SHA is 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505, never the old Solid port. IMPLEMENT: default button with disabled=false, focusableWhenDisabled=false and nativeButton=true. Match native disabled versus aria-disabled/tab-index behavior, type handling, anchor activation, Space/Enter timing, native click dispatch and modifier propagation. Disabled-but-focusable elements retain focus while suppressing pointer, keyboard and default actions, including when disabled changes after focus. Put reusable internal button behavior under packages/solid/src/button/** and document its accessor/ref/event interface for read-only downstream imports; do not write shared internals. Use the events foundation so preventBaseUIHandler suppresses the Base UI handler independently of native preventDefault and change-details cancellation in downstream controls. Preserve source handler merge order. Solid 2 RC.13 requires current callback lookup, accessor-derived disabled state and getter-backed render state; class replaces className and render receives live props/state. Effects use createEffect(compute,effect) and return cleanup; ref callbacks cannot own cleanup. Do not read a just-written signal expecting a synchronous commit. WRITE BOUNDARY: button implementation, colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/button/** and tracking/components/button.json; integration owns root barrels, package exports and lockfile. NON-GOALS: toggle state, toolbar navigation, form validation or a React compatibility layer. VALIDATE: translate Button.test.tsx plus applicable activation assertions from the internal adapter's source behavior. Cover native/custom/link render targets, disabled transitions, keyboard-generated real clicks and modifier keys. Run harness jsdom, browser keyboard and type checks, recording case mappings and commands in the coverage file.
acceptance: Native and custom targets follow the source's activation timing and emit one real click with modifiers.
Disabled and focusableWhenDisabled combinations match focus, tab order and suppression behavior.
Reusable button adapter is contained in button ownership and documented for consumers.
Native prevention and Base UI handler prevention remain independent.
Button conformance, reactive props and source-test coverage pass and are recorded.

title: Implement Toolbar parts and disabled-aware composite focus

READ FIRST: packages/react/src/toolbar/index.ts, index.parts.ts, root/ToolbarRoot.tsx, root/ToolbarRoot.test.tsx, button/ToolbarButton.tsx and button/ToolbarButton.test.tsx, input/ToolbarInput.tsx and input/ToolbarInput.test.tsx, plus group, link and separator implementations and adjacent tests. Use canonical SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505 only. IMPLEMENT: Root, Group, Button, Link, Input and Separator, including orientation/type/data exports. Root is role=toolbar, horizontal by default; composite owns ordered registration and looping. Compute disabledIndices from disabled AND not focusableWhenDisabled, not disabled alone. Propagate root/group disabled state to controls while preserving the source exception for links. Toolbar.Input must preserve text-editing keys and release navigation appropriately when disabled; do not treat it as a plain button. Separator defaults perpendicular to toolbar orientation and permits override. Expose optional toolbar contexts with explicit null and required access through defaultless contexts, ready for later ToggleGroup consumption. Use button's adapter and composite metadata rather than importing Toggle. Solid 2 RC.13 state/metadata must remain getter-backed and derived; read callbacks at invocation, use class/live render callbacks, native events and independent prevention. Effects use compute/effect and return cleanup; refs register disposal at setup. WRITE BOUNDARY: toolbar/**, its colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/toolbar/** and tracking/components/toolbar.json only; no root barrel/export-map/lockfile edits. NON-GOALS: implementing overlays, NumberField or toggles. VALIDATE: translate all part suites and ToolbarLink.spec.tsx, including RTL, disabled initial tab stop, disabled input escape and custom keyboard activation. For not-yet-built foreign components use render-contract fixtures and enumerate real-component replay cases in coverage; do not introduce reverse dependencies. Run published jsdom/browser/type commands and record evidence.
acceptance: All six parts and source data/type exports exist in the family-local entry point.
RTL/orientation/loop navigation skips only disabled non-focusable items and handles dynamic removal.
Disabled propagation preserves link behavior and input editing/navigation semantics.
Toolbar contexts are usable by later ToggleGroup without a Toolbar-to-Toggle import.
Translated tests, contract fixtures and explicitly identified integration replay cases are recorded.

title: Implement ToggleGroup value transactions and toolbar-aware context
description: WHY: Toggle consumes this context; building the group first keeps implementation dependencies acyclic even though React tests compose both components. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/toggle-group/index.ts, ToggleGroup.tsx, ToggleGroupContext.ts, ToggleGroup.test.tsx and packages/react/src/toggle/Toggle.tsx for the consuming transaction. Reference SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505, not the old port. IMPLEMENT: role=group, horizontal orientation, multiple=false, disabled=false, loopFocus=true and source empty-array default semantics. Preserve isValueInitialized based on raw defined value/defaultValue props; it is not equivalent to a nonempty selection. setGroupValue computes an immutable candidate array, invokes the latest onValueChange with the caller's details object, and commits only if uncanceled. Single mode supports deselecting to []; multiple mode adds/removes values without mutating a shared empty default. Combine toolbar/root/group disabled state exactly. Outside Toolbar render through the composite with Home/End navigation; inside Toolbar reuse its registry instead of creating nested roving focus. Do not add aria-orientation to role=group. Make optional context explicitly null and provide getter-backed live value/state. Any effect uses createEffect(compute,effect) with returned cleanup; ref cleanup is setup-owned. WRITE BOUNDARY: toggle-group/**, colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/toggle-group/** and tracking/components/toggle-group.json; shared entry points and lockfile remain integration-owned. NON-GOALS: implementing Toggle or changing Toolbar. VALIDATE: translate ToggleGroup.test.tsx using a family-local context/composite consumer fixture to exercise group behavior before Toggle exists. Record original composed cases for real-Toggle replay by the downstream Toggle worker/integration. Test controlled/uncontrolled arrays, cancellation, RTL/Home/End, disabled inheritance and default isolation with published harness commands.
acceptance: Single and multiple selection compute correct arrays and cancellation prevents commits.
Raw value initialization, missing/empty values and isolated defaults match source behavior.
Standalone groups provide roving focus; toolbar-contained groups reuse the toolbar composite.
Group emits no aria-orientation on role=group and publishes live state.
Source case mappings and downstream real-Toggle replay inventory are recorded without circular dependencies.

title: Implement Toggle with shared item/group cancellation and composition replay
description: WHY: Toggle must work standalone and as a composite item without letting an item cancellation leak into a group commit. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/toggle/index.ts, Toggle.tsx, Toggle.test.tsx, and packages/react/src/toggle-group/ToggleGroup.test.tsx. Canonical SHA is 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505; ignore the old Solid port. IMPLEMENT: defaultPressed=false, disabled=false, nativeButton=true; aria-pressed and pressed/disabled data state; source value/ID fallback including the empty-string fallback. Ignore form/type participation as upstream does: this is not a submit/validation control. Group membership overrides standalone pressed state. Compute nextPressed from the committed value, construct one native change-details object, invoke current onPressedChange first, then group.setGroupValue, and check cancellation after each callback before local commit. Never create separate detail objects for the two callbacks. In a group render through CompositeItem with disabled/focusableWhenDisabled=false metadata so Toolbar skips natively disabled toggles. Preserve warning behavior for omitted explicit values in initialized groups, adapted to framework-native diagnostics. Use button's read-only adapter and existing group contexts, not duplicated mechanics. Solid 2 RC.13 uses class and live render(props,state), getter-backed public state, accessor/memo derivation, createEffect(compute,effect) with returned cleanup, and setup-owned ref cleanup. Ordinary writes are staged; carry candidate values through callbacks rather than rereading setters. WRITE BOUNDARY: toggle/**, colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/toggle/** and tracking/components/toggle.json only. Do not modify group/toolbar coverage or shared export maps; report replay results from this task's file. NON-GOALS: new group APIs, form fields, shared framework changes. VALIDATE: translate Toggle.test.tsx and execute the real ToggleGroup/Toolbar compositions previously deferred. Cover controlled refusal, native keyboard activation, item and group vetoes, disabled navigation and live render props. Record source-title mappings, commands and results in toggle coverage.
acceptance: Standalone controlled/uncontrolled pressed state and source defaults pass.
Item callback precedes group callback using the identical details object; either veto prevents commit.
Grouped toggles participate in standalone and Toolbar composite navigation with correct disabled metadata.
No form submission behavior or consumer type override is introduced.
Toggle tests and real group/toolbar replay evidence are recorded in tracking/components/toggle.json.

title: Implement Avatar loading, delayed fallback and presence lifecycle
description: WHY: Avatar's apparent simplicity hides image races, cached-resource hydration and transition-sensitive fallback timing. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/avatar/index.ts, index.parts.ts, root/AvatarRoot.tsx, image/AvatarImage.tsx, image/useImageLoadingStatus.ts, fallback/AvatarFallback.tsx, their adjacent test files and Avatar.spec.tsx. Use SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505 exclusively. IMPLEMENT: Root, Image and Fallback with idle/loading/loaded/error status, source load-status callbacks, image attributes and cache/error handling. Reproduce keepMounted and transition attributes rather than simply hiding every unloaded image. Delay fallback using lifecycle timers; changing delay to zero reveals it immediately while later delay changes must not hide an already-visible fallback. Handle source replacement, failed cached resources, late callbacks after disposal and success/fallback transitions without duplicate mounted content. Respect SSR cached-image behavior: no fallback flash or replayed entrance animation during hydration. Root defaults to span; use the exact tags and state mapping of each part, including Image data exports. Solid 2 RC.13 state is getter-backed and derived through accessors/memos; effects use createEffect(compute,effect), return timer/listener cleanup, and invoke current callbacks. Register ref disposal at setup, not inside ownerless ref callbacks. Use class/live render callbacks; no React hooks, JSX cloning or Solid 1 APIs. WRITE BOUNDARY: avatar/**, colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/avatar/** and tracking/components/avatar.json. No shared presence changes, root barrel, export-map or lockfile edits. NON-GOALS: image caching service, fetch abstractions or styling. VALIDATE: translate root/image/fallback conformance and timing suites, including cached error notifications, delay transitions and keepMounted animation cases. Use deterministic image/timer fixtures plus browser/SSR hydration tests where actual rendering matters; translate the type spec. Record per-case result, adaptation and command; lifecycle cancellation must prevent updates after unmount.
acceptance: All three parts expose exact loading states and source data attributes.
Delay changes preserve already-visible fallback and canceled work never updates disposed roots.
Cached success/error and source changes invoke current callbacks without spurious idle notifications.
keepMounted, entry/exit and cached-image hydration cases match source behavior.
Translated runtime/type/SSR coverage is recorded in tracking/components/avatar.json.

title: Implement Progress normalized range, status and accessible value parts
description: WHY: Progress must derive accessible text, visual fill and completion from the same normalized range, including non-finite and custom-range values. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/progress/index.ts, index.parts.ts, root/ProgressRoot.tsx and root/ProgressRoot.test.tsx; label/ProgressLabel.test.tsx, value/ProgressValue.test.tsx, indicator/ProgressIndicator.test.tsx and track/ProgressTrack.test.tsx with their implementations. Canonical SHA: 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505; never use the old port. IMPLEMENT: Root, Track, Indicator, Value, Label and Status/type/data exports. min=0 and max=100 default only as source specifies. Null or non-finite values remain indeterminate; finite values produce one clamped value and finite normalized percentage, including equal bounds. Complete means clamped value equals max. Default display/aria text is localized percentage unless format is supplied; getAriaValueText receives formatted text AND original raw value. Preserve the hidden presentation span used for the screen-reader label workaround. Label registration updates and clears aria-labelledby on ID changes/unmount. Value's children callback and every state/data mapping must update in the same reactive turn as range or format props. Solid 2 RC.13 uses getter-backed context/state, accessors/memos rather than effect-mirrored derived values, class and render(liveProps,liveState). Read callbacks when invoked. Required contexts are defaultless; register ref cleanup at setup. Any effect uses createEffect(compute,effect) with returned cleanup, never a Solid 1 effect. WRITE BOUNDARY: progress/**, colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/progress/** and tracking/components/progress.json; integration owns root barrels, package exports and lockfile. NON-GOALS: Meter reuse through a public dependency, progress animation design or new range policy. VALIDATE: translate all five part suites, testing custom ranges, overshoot/undershoot, zero width, equal bounds, status cycles, format changes and label lifecycle. Derive locale expectations with Intl.NumberFormat and record harness commands/results in coverage.
acceptance: Visual percentage, aria-valuenow, visible text and completion status agree for custom ranges and clamped values.
Null/non-finite values expose indeterminate state with source ARIA behavior.
Raw callback arguments, locale/format changes and Value children remain reactive.
All five parts synchronize status and label registration cleans up correctly.
Source suites and conformance/type coverage are mapped and passing.

title: Implement Meter finite range outputs and reactive accessible labeling
description: WHY: Meter reports a measurement rather than task completion and must preserve its own NaN/infinity policy instead of inheriting Progress semantics. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/meter/index.ts, index.parts.ts, root/MeterRoot.tsx, root/MeterRoot.test.tsx and adjacent implementation/test pairs for label, value, indicator and track. Use /Users/avi/avir-oss/ref/base-ui at 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505 as the only source. IMPLEMENT: Root, Track, Indicator, Value and Label with role=meter, min=0/max=100 defaults, clamped aria-valuenow and normalized percentage fill. Source explicitly substitutes min for NaN value and zero for NaN percentage while clamp handles infinities; reproduce those distinctions and finite equal-bound output. Format the clamped number when format exists, otherwise the normalized percentage; getAriaValueText gets formatted and raw values. Preserve Root's hidden presentation span, label ID registration/cleanup, Indicator positioning styles and Value callback arguments. Meter has no Progress status lifecycle: do not manufacture status attributes or public exports absent from index.ts. Use Solid 2 RC.13 accessor/memo calculations and getter-backed context so changes to value, min, max, locale and format update all parts without a stale render. Use class and live render callbacks, defaultless required contexts and setup-owned ref cleanup. Any effects use createEffect(compute,effect) and return cleanup; callbacks are read at invocation and ordinary writes are not immediately reread. WRITE BOUNDARY: meter/**, colocated tests/fixtures, docs/components/meter/** and tracking/components/meter.json. Root barrels, package export maps and lockfile remain integration-owned. NON-GOALS: depending on public Progress, adding thresholds/colors, or altering range semantics. VALIDATE: translate all five upstream suites, especially nonzero minima, clamp/format agreement, equal ranges, dynamic callback arguments, label replacement and custom renderer conformance. Use Intl-derived locale expectations and published harness runtime/type commands; record source cases and evidence in coverage.
acceptance: All five parts match source tags, semantics and family exports.
NaN, infinities, equal bounds and out-of-range inputs yield the source's finite fill and clamped ARIA values.
Range/format/locale changes update visible text, ARIA and fill consistently.
Label replacement and unmount remove stale associations; callbacks receive raw values.
All applicable Meter tests and Solid-native type checks are recorded.

title: Implement Collapsible cancelable disclosure and measured panel lifecycle
description: WHY: Collapsible supplies disclosure behavior reused by Accordion, including difficult interrupted transitions and hidden-until-found handling. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/collapsible/index.ts, index.parts.ts, root/CollapsibleRoot.tsx, root/useCollapsibleRoot.ts, trigger/CollapsibleTrigger.tsx, panel/CollapsiblePanel.tsx and all three adjacent test suites. Synchronize generated/manual panel IDs with aria-controls through removal/remount. Preserve keepMounted, hiddenUntilFound precedence, beforematch opening, panel dimension CSS variables and starting/ending state attributes. Opening measurement must preserve inline alignment; closing restores measured dimensions before motion. Handle zero-size exits, initially-open SSR without entrance replay, reopen-during-exit and late animation completions. A canceled beforematch must not suppress a subsequent legitimate animation; a controlled refusal must re-collapse the temporary reveal. Reuse presence/lifecycle foundations and keep any Accordion-consumable disclosure adapter within collapsible ownership. Solid 2 RC.13 ordinary writes are staged: explicitly coordinate the immediate DOM requirements of beforematch rather than rereading a setter. Derive public state with getters/accessors, use class/live render callbacks, native events and independent details.cancel/preventBaseUIHandler. Effects use compute/effect with returned cleanup; refs have setup-owned disposal and required contexts no default. NON-GOALS: roving focus, new animation policy, React flushSync emulation. VALIDATE: translate all root/trigger/panel cases, including the extensive browser animation and beforematch suite, plus controlled cancellation and state callback conformance. Run actual harness jsdom/browser/SSR/type commands; record every applicable case and exact evidence. Document any impossible immediate-native seam as a blocker rather than substituting behavior.
acceptance: Controlled/uncontrolled opening, disabled activation and both cancellation paths match source.
Manual/generated IDs cleanly unregister and reconnect on replacement.
Panel dimensions, transition attributes, keepMounted and initial SSR behavior pass browser tests.
Interrupted motion and hidden-until-found beforematch/refusal cases recover correctly.
Reusable disclosure seam stays within family ownership and full case coverage is recorded.

VALIDATE: translate every applicable part test, emphasizing controlled cancellation, array values, source data attributes, label changes and panel exit when switching selection. acceptance: Five parts support source generic values, single/multiple mode and intact array-valued items.

title: Implement Tabs selection, panel registration and measured indicator
description: WHY: Tabs requires coordinated selection, focus and geometry, especially when controlled selection and DOM registration change together. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/tabs/index.ts, index.parts.ts, root/TabsRoot.tsx, list/TabsList.tsx, tab/TabsTab.tsx, panel/TabsPanel.tsx, indicator/TabsIndicator.tsx, its prehydrationScript.template.js, and all five adjacent test suites. IMPLEMENT: five parts, horizontal default and source defaultValue=0 semantics including explicit defaults, disabled automatic selection and null/unmatched selection. Preserve selection reasons and activationDirection based on DOM order with the source fallback when a newly selected tab has not registered. List handles activation mode, RTL/orientation, looping and distinction between focusable-disabled and natively disabled tabs. Keep aria-controls/labelledby registrations safe when duplicate panel values shadow each other or keyed tabs disappear. Panel preserves keepMounted and transition state. Indicator measures active tab size/position through scroll, borders, transformed ancestors, resize and ref replacement, exposing exact CSS variables/state. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/slider/thumb/SliderThumb.tsx, SliderThumb.test.tsx, label/SliderLabel.tsx and SliderLabel.test.tsx, track/SliderTrack.tsx and SliderTrack.test.tsx, root/SliderRoot.test.tsx keyboard/Form/Field sections and root/SliderRoot.spec.tsx. Canonical SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505. IMPLEMENT: Thumb, Label and Track plus native range-input registration and Value output association. Keep the hidden/nested input as source-defined sibling content under custom render callbacks; forwarded inputRef, focus and blur currentTarget must be the native input. Match min/max/step/name/form, per-thumb ARIA labels/value text, getAriaValueText precedence, disabled state and tab order. Source keyboard matrix includes RTL/orientation arrows, Shift largeStep, PageUp/Down and Home/End with collision/minimum-distance rules; no-op or canceled keys do not commit. Preserve original event target semantics under the native-events contract rather than manufacturing React event clones; document any legacy event-target convenience adaptation in coverage/types. Field blur validation waits until focus leaves the range, and disabling/unmounting a non-focused sibling must not erase the active thumb's focus ownership. Label focuses a registered input or safely does nothing without one; external form submission uses clamped values. Solid 2 RC.13 uses getter-backed state, accessor/memo derivation, class/live render callbacks, current callbacks and staged transactions. Effects return cleanup via compute/effect; refs dispose from setup. WRITE BOUNDARY: slider/**, family tests/fixtures/docs/coverage only; no shared foundation or central exports. NON-GOALS: pointer capture, measured thumb alignment, indicator geometry or prehydration scripts. VALIDATE: translate keyboard/ARIA/forms/label/track/type cases, including excess thumbs avoiding NaN and controlled external changes. Run harness jsdom/browser/type checks; assign remaining layout/pointer cases to bsolid-c-slider-gestures and record evidence.
acceptance: Native range inputs carry correct constraints, names/form ownership, labels and inputRef behavior.
RTL/orientation/modifier/Home/End/Page key matrix matches source and suppresses no-op/canceled commits.
Range focus ownership and validation remain correct across sibling movement, disable and removal.
Label and Value associate with current registered inputs; form projection submits clamped values.
Type/native-event adaptations and completed keyboard cases are recorded with remaining gesture cases assigned.

title: Complete Slider pointer/touch gestures, alignment and indicator geometry

Reference SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505 only. IMPLEMENT: Control and Indicator, pointer/touch handlers and measured center/edge alignment for existing thumbs. Preserve nearest/stacked thumb selection, source tie-breaking, disabled thumbs, horizontal RTL and vertical geometry, inset thumb size and grabbed-center offset. Push/swap/none collisions use stage-one math and gesture-start snapshots; switching to an unrendered thumb clears stale offsets. Track presses retain single-element array shape and Control has no default tabIndex. Capture/release/cancel and touch continuation after browser pointer cancellation must match upstream, with exactly the source change/commit reasons and dragging threshold. Last-used thumb stacking, output/indicator positioning and all data attributes remain reactive. Adapt edge-aligned prehydration sizing and CSP behavior to Solid SSR without importing React streaming markers. Native event target is not rewritten for pointer events. Solid 2 RC.13 ordinary writes are staged; gesture-local refs/candidates own synchronous pointer state, while public state uses getters/accessors/memos. Class/live render callbacks and current callbacks remain intact; effects return cleanup and setup owns ref disposal. WRITE BOUNDARY: slider/** and family fixtures/docs/coverage only. NON-GOALS: changing shared gestures or root export maps/lockfile. VALIDATE: translate remaining Control/Thumb/Indicator/Root cases, including dropped refs, impossible distance, canceled gestures, resize/alignment and touch fallback. Run real-browser geometry/capture plus SSR/hydration/type checks, then audit all seven parts and reconcile tracking/components/slider.json; no in-family case may remain unassigned or silently skipped.
acceptance: Track/thumb selection, offsets and collision policies match source in horizontal RTL and vertical layouts.
Capture, canceled gestures and touch fallback clean up and emit correct change/commit sequences.
Thumb alignment, indicator positioning and stacking pass real layout tests.
Custom renderers dropping refs degrade safely and prehydration/CSP behavior is documented and tested.
All seven parts and full Slider coverage audit are complete.

title: Build OTPField root normalization, slot registry and native validation model

Use canonical SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505, never the old port. IMPLEMENT: Root/model plus the Separator alias, ordered slot registry and getter-backed root context consumed in stage two. length is required; preserve validation for invalid lengths, defaultValue='', validationType=numeric, autoComplete=one-time-code, autoSubmit=false and mask=false. Port numeric/alpha/alphanumeric/none normalization, whitespace stripping, custom normalization ordering and revalidation, clamping, middle replacement and suffix preservation. Track rejected characters separately from accepted normalized values. Root hidden validation input exposes source name/form/pattern/length constraints before hydration; generate first-slot and derived IDs and merge description/label ownership as source. Field-core handles validation/registration, logical string value and dirty/fill state. Define accepted-value transaction, pending focus/completion tokens and stale-attempt invalidation now, while user-triggered completion/autosubmit is stage two. Solid 2 RC.13 staged writes require explicit candidate/result handoff rather than setter rereads. Use accessor/memo derivation, getter-backed public state, class/live render callbacks and current callbacks with independent native/Base UI cancellation. Effects use compute/effect with returned cleanup; slot ref disposal registers at setup. WRITE BOUNDARY: otp-field/**, family tests/fixtures/docs and tracking/components/otp-field.json; Separator and shared core/export maps are read-only. NON-GOALS: slot keyboard/paste/IME handlers or automatic submission yet. VALIDATE: translate utility and root-model/SSR/type cases using a registry fixture, including grouped slot ordering and overlong values. Assign interactive cases to bsolid-c-otp-field-editing and record actual harness commands/results.
acceptance: Normalization and replacement utilities match all source validation modes and custom-normalizer ordering.
Required length, defaults and SSR hidden validation markup are source-exact.
Ordered slot registration and ID/label/description contracts remain reactive and cleanly disposable.
Accepted-value and pending action tokens distinguish canceled/stale attempts without synchronous setter assumptions.
Root/model/type coverage is recorded and interactive cases are assigned to the next stage.

title: Complete OTP slot editing, IME, accepted completion and form autosubmit
description: WHY: OTP focus and completion must follow accepted controlled values, not merely attempted edits, while native input composition differs on Android. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/otp-field/input/OTPFieldInput.tsx, OTPFieldInput.test.tsx, OTPFieldInput.android.test.tsx and OTPFieldInput.spec.tsx; root/OTPFieldRoot.tsx, OTPFieldRoot.test.tsx and OTPFieldRoot.react17.test.tsx. Reference SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505. IMPLEMENT: Input slots with render-order indexing, first-empty-slot focus, source RTL arrows/Home/End/vertical navigation, selection, deletion, multi-character input and middle paste. Canceled typing/backspace/paste leaves focus unchanged. ReadOnly retains navigation but blocks mutation; disabled behavior is distinct. Buffer composition until compositionend except the source Android incremental path; discard composition ending after disable/readOnly. Preserve first-slot shared-label precedence, autocomplete only on first slot, mask/type overrides and per-slot complete/filled/active attributes. Report rejected input before accepted value updates with correct reason. Consume pending tokens so asynchronously accepted controlled values advance focus/complete once, stale attempts never fire later, and unrelated complete prop changes do not synthesize user completion. Hidden-input autofill uses the same normalization. autoSubmit uses the correct owning/external form and requestSubmit after DOM/native value synchronization, preserving invalid-form focus; no React flushSync substitute or immediate staged-state reread. Solid 2 RC.13 uses getters/accessors/memos, current callbacks, class/live render props, native independent cancellation and compute/effect returned cleanup; refs clean up from setup. WRITE BOUNDARY: otp-field/** plus family docs/fixtures/coverage only; Form/core/Separator/central exports are read-only. NON-GOALS: SMS retrieval, password-manager integrations beyond source input handling or new validation policy. VALIDATE: translate all remaining slot/root/platform/type/SSR cases, including missing clipboard data, controlled delay, autofill and external form association. Run harness browser/jsdom/SSR/type checks, audit Root/Input/Separator exports and finish tracking/components/otp-field.json with explicit framework-only adaptations.
acceptance: Keyboard, paste, deletion, selection and readOnly/disabled focus behavior match source in LTR/RTL.
Desktop and Android composition paths commit correctly and discard forbidden late composition.
Canceled/stale controlled attempts never move focus, complete or submit; accepted async updates do so once.
Autofill and autoSubmit use synchronized native values and correct form ownership without stealing invalid-field focus.
All parts, type specs, SSR and complete source coverage are reconciled.

IMPLEMENT: structural Root/Viewport/Content/Scrollbar/Thumb/Corner and their context/ref registration, native-scroll observation and overflow computation; stage two adds active gestures. Preserve focusable viewport semantics, aria-hidden scrollbar/corner defaults and overrides, orientation/keepMounted behavior, minimum thumb size, corner sizing and source padding/margin/overlay-scrollbar rules. Normalize RTL offsets and scalar/per-edge overflowEdgeThreshold; update all source data attributes and root/viewport/scrollbar CSS variables when direction, thresholds, content size or visibility changes. Measure content mounted after the initial viewport, clear stale metrics when overflow disappears and recover before the first observer callback. Preserve overscroll thumb shrink/pinning and source CSS.registerProperty optimization with the WebKit exception. CSP nonce/disableStyleElements controls injected scrollbar styles. Avoid broadcasting unchanged metrics through every part. Solid 2 RC.13 uses getter-backed state, accessor/memo derivation, class/live render callbacks, current callbacks and owner-document DOM helpers. Effects use createEffect(compute,effect) with returned observer/listener cleanup; ref cleanup registers at setup, and staged setters are not immediately reread to compute geometry. WRITE BOUNDARY: scroll-area/** plus family fixtures/docs/coverage only; no provider/DOM/central export edits. NON-GOALS: custom drag/wheel/snap control yet. VALIDATE: translate layout/Root/Viewport/Content/Corner cases in a real browser with harness measurement fixtures, plus conformance/type/SSR checks. Map every case in tracking/components/scroll-area.json and assign gesture/modality cases explicitly to bsolid-c-scroll-area-gestures.
acceptance: All six structural parts render with source accessibility and registration contracts.
Overflow thresholds, RTL, dynamic content/visibility and no-overflow clearing update exact metrics/data/CSS variables.

title: Complete ScrollArea drag, wheel chaining, modality and snap restoration
description: WHY: Native scrollbar replacement must preserve pointer ownership, scroll chaining and snap restoration even when consumer callbacks unmount parts mid-event. READ FIRST: packages/react/src/scroll-area/root/ScrollAreaRoot.tsx, scrollbar/ScrollAreaScrollbar.tsx and ScrollAreaScrollbar.test.tsx, thumb/ScrollAreaThumb.tsx and ScrollAreaThumb.test.tsx, viewport/ScrollAreaViewport.tsx and ScrollAreaViewport.test.tsx, constants.ts and utils/getOffset.ts. Use canonical SHA 19511bb171f3b360b006c94cf6d07e53cb446505. IMPLEMENT: thumb dragging and track jump-to-click, primary-button guards, active pointer capture, second-pointer rejection and recovery after silently lost capture. Preserve negative RTL range and no-op behavior when thumb fills/exceeds the track. Disable viewport scrollSnapType throughout a gesture, save it once and restore on release/cancel/disposal; the initial jump must not snap. Wheel handlers clamp by axis, prevent default only when consuming scroll, allow chaining at edges, ignore zero deltas and ctrl zoom, and update scrolling flags only for consumed motion. Hover excludes touch and follows native composed paths across shadow DOM. Preserve timeout-based scrolling attributes, mouse programmatic-scroll suppression and touch modality exceptions, including switching back to mouse. Recheck node/ref availability after user callbacks that can synchronously unmount viewport/scrollbar. Solid 2 RC.13 uses event-local pointer latches for synchronous work and getter-backed accessor/memo state for rendering; never reread an ordinary staged setter. Use class/live render callbacks, native independent prevention and current callbacks. Effects use compute/effect with returned cleanup; refs/timers/capture disposal registers at setup. WRITE BOUNDARY: scroll-area/**, family tests/fixtures/docs and coverage only. NON-GOALS: general gesture foundation changes or central barrels/exports/lockfile. VALIDATE: translate remaining scrollbar/thumb/viewport cases in a real browser, including nested wheel chaining, snap, RTL, missing refs and unmount-in-callback races. Re-run relevant stage-one geometry regressions, audit all six parts/data/CSS exports, and finish tracking/components/scroll-area.json with commands and explicit environment evidence.
acceptance: Thumb/track gestures preserve pointer ownership, RTL offsets and safe degenerate geometry behavior.
Scroll snap is restored on every completion/cancel/disposal path and never overwritten by a second pointer.
Wheel consumes only movable scroll and preserves edge chaining and browser zoom.
Hover/modality/programmatic-scroll flags match source and late callbacks cannot touch disposed nodes.
Full ScrollArea export and coverage audit includes real-browser geometry/gesture evidence.
